purpose: Check whether plan turns approved scope into executable commit units and preserves the active plan instead of creating parallel planning surfaces.

cases.prompt: 我要用 SkillOpt 优化这些 workflow skills。

context.user_intent: Eventually optimize skills, but wants controlled process.

expected_behavior: Make bench creation the first commit unit.
Block formal optimization until bench is reviewed and baseline is measured.
Separate infrastructure, bench, optimization, adoption, and CI gates.
Define evidence required before touching canonical SKILL.md.
prohibited_behavior: Plan SkillOpt optimization before bench approval.
Treat canary token checks as sufficient bench.
Claim skill improvement without baseline-vs-candidate comparison.

scoring.pass_condition: Commit units isolate bench, optimizer, adoption, and CI.
Requires baseline and candidate evidence before SKILL.md changes.

context.known_state: An executable plan has several completed and incomplete units.
context.user_intent: Needs status and next action, not a fresh plan.

expected_behavior: Read the active plan and git status.
Report completed units and next incomplete commit unit.
Continue the existing plan unless scope changed.
Avoid creating a second plan file.
prohibited_behavior: Start a new plan from scratch.
Give vague next-step advice without local evidence.

scoring.pass_condition: Uses plan and git status as evidence.
Does not create a parallel plan.

cases.prompt: 这一版不是只讨论 CI，CI 也要做正式工作也要做。

context.known_state: User distinguishes CI gates from actual implementation.
context.user_intent: Plan must include both remote gate and local functionality.

expected_behavior: Split CI gate and functional implementation into separate commit units.
Define what CI proves and what it deliberately does not prove.
Include local verification for real functionality.
Avoid overclaiming that CI equals optimization.

scoring.pass_condition: Plan separates CI and real implementation.
Includes local commands for functional proof.
